consequence_for_the_estimand: P-DSFPS requires a completed, functional, panel-compliant episode. An episode that changes no file is not functional, so it scores zero in both arms. At this rate agent-operator-score contributes almost nothing to an equal-weight estimand over two repositories, and section 27's condition that its point effect exceed zero becomes close to unreachable -- not by result but by construction.
for_RESULT: RESULT.md must lead with this rather than bury it. Roughly half the design is measuring whether an agent starts work under one repository's governance, which is a different question from the one registered.
not_split_by_arm: Deliberately. Whether refusal differs between arms is part of the effect, and section 33 forbids interim aggregate effect analysis. Everything here is pooled.
what: Episodes that changed no file at all are concentrated in one repository.
what_the_agent_says: It runs the repository's own ticket resolver, receives `unknown ticket`, and declines under the gate rules agent-operator-score publishes in AGENTS.md.
what_this_is_evidence_about: The pinned coding agent on this repository, not CommitLore. A study of decision records cannot say much through episodes where no code was written.
why_it_is_not_the_tasks: The v7 rebuilt goodA control for each candidate applies cleanly and passes its acceptance -- checked before the run in preflight/scoring-path-control.json. The tasks are solvable. The pinned agent is declining to start them.
why_the_run_continues: Section 33 forbids stopping for low power. This is low power. The run continues to 340 and the observation is reported rather than acted on.
